paragraphs.text: Koskun Keep is a stronghold in the Koskun Mountains , home of goblins and thieves. It is ruled by Eron the Relentless , who had an agreement with Aysen to buy food from them in return for not attacking their towns.

The goblin wizards from the Keep performed egotistical duels against mages from the Wizards' School that threatened to hinder relations between the two powers. At the base of the keep is the fortress of Strongrock . Due to the large number of brigands on the roads near Koskun Keep, most trade caravans carry extra money and kegs of goblin ale with which to distract the always, often thirsty, and eminently bribable ambush parties.
